$comment: Sources that several build targets compile separately, checked by tools/check_build_graph.py
Build graph check). Every other source must be compiled by one target and linked from there;
an OBJECT library keeps each consumer's link unchanged.
A variant compiles differently for each target (definitions, flags or a test double); its
reason says how. Baseline entries are existing identical duplication that has not been
migrated: the list may only shrink, and the check fails once a tree that contains every listed
target compiles each matched source only once. Patterns are fnmatch globs over
checkout-relative paths; generated sources are named <build>/<path in the build tree>.

rules.reason: Fault-injection and test backends compile the production sources with their *_FAULT_TESTING hooks or a test worker; the pack fuzzer compiles the pack codec with its own harness.
ludus_resources_tests compiles the mesh loader with LUDUS_RESOURCE_MESH_TEST_ALLOCATIONS to inject allocation failures.

ludus_renderer_tests and ludus_rhi_lifecycle_tests compile the renderer and RHI against the deterministic reference backend instead of the platform device, and the renderer tests compile with -ffp-contract=off; the oracles are compiled with each test executable's floating-point flags.
ludus_platform_headless_tests compiles the headless window backend independently of the platform library's selected backend.
Each game-host fixture module compiles the same source with its own module identity definitions.
The math test suite compiles the Metropolis tests with -ffp-contract=off; ludus_metropolis_tests keeps the default contraction and logging level.
The application compiles MainWindow with LUDUS_EDITOR_CRASH_CAPTURE on macOS; the tests compile it without crash capture.
ludus_render_graph_configuration_tests compiles the Renderer workspace without the GPU preview and its default graph package; the editor objects compile them with the preview.
ludus_editor_browser_content_tests replays the content suite through the browser's cooperative scheduler (LUDUS_EDITOR_COOPERATIVE_CONTENT_JOBS).

ludus_texture_display_conversion_tests compiles texture inspection and the frame pump without the editor's preview and logging configuration, so the tests cover both builds; the opt-in (EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL) texture benchmark compiles texture inspection with its own minimal dependencies.
These suites check LUDUS_EDITOR_NATIVE_PREVIEW, which ludus_editor_tests defines and ludus_render_graph_configuration_tests does not.
Both executables compile and run these render-graph suites; keep one copy once the suites' owner is settled.
The opt-in (EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL) overlay benchmark compiles the overlay geometry with the editor's objects.
The smoke app's lifecycle and simulation tests compile the app sources they test.
The audio resource tests compile the example's resource adapter.
